kind.name: channels-feature
kind.purpose: Building Channels itself: mailing lists → channels rename, mentions, threads, UI. Screenshots and design questions here.

root.body:
I think clicking on a "task" in the slack UI should just open a modal overlay that shows it and the full thing, rather than navigating out of the slack UI.

And there should be a "EyE" button that lets us open a reply from a slack agent so if we want to dig in more t see that whole convention ad what message is sent the tool use they do etc... it open the conversations UI, sort of like a debug UI.
